thread:
kai: Quick PR opened to add a synthetic usage dataset + example dashboard panels for the rate/quotas docs. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4321 -- I added a 100-row CSV and a panel JSON, but want a quick review on the billing examples + SDK snippet alignment.

maria: Thanks! Can you paste the CSV header here so I can check column names vs our metering pipeline? Also please include the rate-limit headers example for SDK v2 (we keep hitting docs mismatch on that).

kai: CSV header is:

```csv
timestamp_iso,user_id,plan,tokens_consumed,route,status
```

and one sample row: `2026-03-15T14:05:00Z,user_123,pro,120,/v1/generate,200`

Also added a panel file at `docs/assets/panels/metering-summary.json` that expects `plan` to be one of `free,pro,enterprise` so the chart stacks correctly.

devon: That looks good. A couple of asks:
- Add a small section (one paragraph) that explains burst credits and how they show up in the dashboard (we should show both gross tokens and net tokens after credits).
- SDK snippets: include a python requests example showing the `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, and `X-RateLimit-Reset` headers.

amelia: There's also a stale link in `docs/billing/overview.md` referencing the old Grafana panel path. Can someone search/replace to point to the new `docs/assets/panels/metering-summary.json`?

kai: I'll do the link fix in the PR. For the SDK snippet I'm pasting a tiny python example — feel free to trim:

```python
import requests
headers = {
  'Authorization': 'Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY',
  'X-Client-Name': 'sdk-sample',
}
resp = requests.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', json={'prompt': 'hello'}, headers=headers)
print('status', resp.status_code)
print('limit', resp.headers.get('X-RateLimit-Limit'))
print('remaining', resp.headers.get('X-RateLimit-Remaining'))
print('reset', resp.headers.get('X-RateLimit-Reset'))
```

maria: Perfect. For metering CSV, can we include a `billing_event_id` column? It helps trace back to ingestion logs when customers report discrepancies. Also please add a short note about timezone normalization (we expect ISO UTC).

kai: Added `billing_event_id` and a short note in the CSV example. CSV now:

```csv
timestamp_iso,billing_event_id,user_id,plan,tokens_consumed,route,status
2026-03-15T14:05:00Z,evt_01a2b3c,user_123,pro,120,/v1/generate,200
```

devon: I'll draft the burst credits paragraph and a tiny calc example showing how net tokens = tokens_consumed - burst_credit_applied. Also will add a small mock dataset of 5 rows illustrating a burst spike and how the panel annotation should render.

docs-ci-bot: CI pipeline: docs linkcheck passed, markdown linter passed, generated panels validated.

amelia: One more nit: under `docs/pricing/tiers.md` we say "per-minute quotas" but the panel aggregates per-hour. Let's add a caution note so readers don't misinterpret the charts.

kai: Good catch — updated `tiers.md` with a short caution.

maria: Reviewer plan: I can review CSV/headers and the prose. Devon to own panel JSON tweaks & burst section. Amelia to verify link replacements. Aim to merge by Friday EOD.

devon: I'll push a small follow-up commit for the panel colors and a sample Grafana links snippet.

kai: Awesome — thanks everyone. I'll add a changelog entry in the PR description summarizing the artifacts: `examples/synthetic-usage.csv`, `assets/panels/metering-summary.json`, `snippets/sdk_rateheaders.py`, and the small docs edits.

maria: :thumbsup:

devon: LGTM once the panel colors are tweaked.

amalie (typo reaction): (no action)

kai: Merging after approvals, will tag release notes with "docs: add synthetic usage examples and sample panel"
